data.title: 埃塔 · 古代遗迹的密纹解读
data.description: 古代遗迹深处，埃塔举着拓印纸贴在刻满密纹的石壁上。别人要研究三个月的古代文字，她看一眼就打着哈欠说出了大意。
data.location: ancient ruins chamber with rune-covered stone walls, fallen pillars and dust in light shafts
data.action: holding a rubbing sheet against a rune-covered wall, examining the glyphs with sudden sharp focus
data.lighting: 遗迹裂缝漏下的光柱与尘埃
data.promptProse: Before a wall of ancient runes, Eta yawns — then reads them like a shopping list. Three months of work, done before lunch.
data.animaCaption: Ancient scripts fear Eta. She fears only early mornings.
